slides.title: Sector Exposure & Executive Risk Outlook
slides.decision: Set the sector thesis and evidence boundary for Risk Committee discussion.
slides.executive_conclusion: Connected generation, remote operations and shared digital dependencies expand the sector exposure surface; no reviewed source establishes a quantified EU or UK September 2026 sector incident.
slides.speaker_notes: No sources, URLs, dates, footnotes or metadata. Traceability remains in the evidence pack.

slides.title: Key Threats & Top 5 Cyber Attacks
slides.decision: Rank the threat patterns that can impair energy-sector operational visibility, control or recovery.
slides.executive_conclusion: Remote-access exposure, exposed engineering systems, ransomware on edge infrastructure, destructive malware and dependency targeting are the priority public patterns.
slides.speaker_notes: No sources, URLs, dates, footnotes or metadata. Traceability remains in the evidence pack.

slides.title: Financial Impact: European Energy and Utilities
slides.decision: Explain sector financial and operational transmission without creating a bank-loss estimate.
slides.executive_conclusion: Loss of visibility or control can prompt operating restrictions and recovery demand before any customer supply interruption is observed.
slides.speaker_notes: No sources, URLs, dates, footnotes or metadata. Traceability remains in the evidence pack.

slides.title: Financial Impact: Worst-Case Scenarios
slides.decision: Test three plausible high-impact pathways and their monitoring indicators.
slides.executive_conclusion: The most decision-relevant stress pathways combine shared digital dependencies, exposed operational technology and uncertainty over IT-to-OT separation.
slides.speaker_notes: No sources, URLs, dates, footnotes or metadata. Traceability remains in the evidence pack.

slides.title: Case Study: Colonial Pipeline Ransomware Incident
slides.decision: Demonstrate a completed historical causal chain and define its bounded read-across.
slides.executive_conclusion: The historical lesson is that uncertainty about IT-to-OT separation can drive a precautionary operating decision and multi-party restoration coordination.
slides.speaker_notes: No sources, URLs, dates, footnotes or metadata. Traceability remains in the evidence pack.

slides.title: Systemic Dependencies & Regulatory Outlook
slides.decision: Identify formal dependency-monitoring expectations and regulatory developments that change the sector outlook.
slides.executive_conclusion: EU electricity rules formalise dependency and cross-border propagation assessment; Great Britain is considering a wider downstream energy perimeter.
